name: Pigeonhole Obstruction Framing
description: Instead of explicitly describing a triangle (three mutually connected vertices), the problem asks for a set of three elements that cannot be 2-colored without monochromatic edges. By the Pigeonhole Principle, any 3 elements distributed into 2 sets must have 2 in the same set; for this to always cause a violation, all 3 pairs must be edges. This forces the model to logically deduce that the required structure is a triangle, breaking simple pattern matching.
